title: i loved playing speed growing up
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
My sister used to beat me at Speed every... single... time.... BUT it was still one of my favourite card games growing up, even though I rarely won LOL

So I made an online version for eggverse to bring back memories and to start new ones. 

For those who don't know speed, its fairly simple. The goal is to get rid of your cards as fast as possible by playing one number higher or lower than the cards in the middle.   
  
No turns. Just you & your opponent duking it out. 

Would love for other people to try it and tell me what they think. Anyone else grow up playing this/still play Speed? 

[Play Speed on eggverse](https://eggverse.co)
